hints.tr: Başlangıç kodu `@` olmayan metinde `ValueError` veriyor. Önce `if "@" not in address: return "***"`.
hints.en: The starter code raises `ValueError` on text with no `@`. First `if "@" not in address: return "***"`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def mask_email(address):
    if "@" not in address:
        return "***"
    user, domain = address.split("@", 1)
    return user[0] + "***@" + domain

print(mask_email("ada@example.org"))
print(mask_email("bob@mail.example.org"))
print(mask_email("not-an-address"))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def mask_email(address):
    if "@" not in address:
        return "***"
    user, domain = address.split("@", 1)
    return user[0] + "***@" + domain

print(mask_email("ada@example.org"))
print(mask_email("bob@mail.example.org"))
print(mask_email("not-an-address"))
```
